pregame.whyWatch: Division game: Texans 0-4, 3rd in the AFC South; Titans 0-4, 4th in the AFC South.
pregame.pressurePoint: Texans run game vs Titans run defense. The Titans are No. 12 of 32 against the run (39%) and No. 18 by EPA a carry (-0.06). The Texans rank No. 32 in rush success rate (30%) and No. 30 in EPA a carry (-0.22). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Titans erase the run. The Texans get pushed into passing downs, and that is where this defense makes its money. Watch Texans yards per carry through the first quarter. Under 3 and the game plan has to change.

edges.why: The Titans are No. 12 of 32 against the run (39%) and No. 18 by EPA a carry (-0.06). The Texans rank No. 32 in rush success rate (30%) and No. 30 in EPA a carry (-0.22). The Titans are No. 9 of 32 on passing downs (33%). The Texans rank No. 27 in passing-downs success (29%). This is not a lean. It is a mismatch, and a prominent one. The Titans get off the field on long downs. Early-down efficiency is everything for the Texans.

The Texans are No. 11 of 32 against the run (39%) and No. 12 by EPA a carry (-0.10). The Titans rank No. 22 in rush success rate (38%) and No. 16 in EPA a carry (-0.05). A real edge, not a lock. The Titans will find the run hard going. Expect more second-and-long than usual.

The Texans are No. 28 in pass explosiveness (1.18) and No. 14 in pass success rate (47%), and the Titans are No. 25 at limiting explosive passes (1.38) and No. 21 in pass success allowed (47%). Strength on strength. The Texans take shots and the Titans give up few. Whoever wins the first deep ball changes the other side's call sheet.
